name: Bowmiya
wishText: Some bonds are chosen, yet they feel just as strong.
textInChatBox: Thank you for the kindness and care you've shared. I’m not here to intrude, only to honor you with my best wishes.
text2: I wondered how best to express it...
text5Content: I simply wish you joy, success, and endless happiness.
outroText: That’s all—no expectations, just a sincere wish from the heart.
